historical_uncertainty: Karma Sakha describes Row 1899 and 1906 printings as only 16 chapters; these are edition-level differences, not yet independently validated.
Search engine also retains an older VedicPupil page with 1,891 verses/17 chapters; live page says 1,979, so older snippets are not a current verse census.
No verse-index concordance may be inferred solely from shared chapter number.
A 17-chapter outline of the Bhasin book does not mean all extant Sanskrit editions have exactly those chapters.
prerequisites_for_alignment: Record edition + chapter title + verse headword and Sanskrit incipit + physical printed page whenever comparing source verses
Do not assume Karma 6.58 matches Bhasin 6.58 without actual witness
Avoid calling either online site a critical edition
